This mission will require you to destroy an Academy target Kestrel in Levo space. The Kestrel itself will be at half-power, but its fighters will be fully armed. For missions such as this, where you must destroy the ship, we recommed that you go after the Kestrel first and avoid its fighters if possible. It is not necessary to destroy fighters in most missions of this type. When you have destroyed the Kestrel, return to ConEx. Good luck.
